ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is a rectangular prism, and division grids are drawn on the outer surface. On the front face, two vertical internal division lines and two horizontal internal division lines can be seen, indicating that it is divided into 3 segments in each of two directions; the grid lines on the top face and the right side face continue extending backward, indicating that the third direction is also divided into 3 segments. Therefore this rectangular prism is divided into 3×3×3=27 small rectangular prisms, corresponding to a total of six internal cutting planes: there are two cutting planes in the direction parallel to each group of opposite faces. Reasoning: Let the three side lengths of the original rectangular prism be a, b, c, then the original surface area is X=2(ab+ac+bc). Two cuts are parallel to a group of faces with area ab; each cut will produce two new internally exposed faces, so the newly added area is 2×2ab=4ab. Similarly, two cuts are parallel to a group of faces with area ac, adding 4ac; two cuts are parallel to a group of faces with area bc, adding 4bc. The newly added area from all cuts is 4(ab+ac+bc). Since X=2(ab+ac+bc), the newly added area equals 2X. The total surface area of all 27 small rectangular prisms equals the original outer surface area plus all newly added cut surface areas, namely X+2X=3X. Final answer: 3X

raw_record.question_text: A cuboid with surface area $X$ is cut up along six planes parallel to the sides (see diagram). What is the total surface area of all 27 thus created solids?

method.method_draft: Use an incremental cutting-area argument. From the image, read that the cuboid is divided into 3 layers in each of the three directions, so there are two internal cut planes parallel to each pair of opposite faces, for six planes total. Let the original cuboid have side lengths a, b, c, so its surface area from the text is X = 2(ab + ac + bc). Each internal cut parallel to the ab faces creates two new exposed faces of total area 2ab; since there are two such cuts, they add 4ab. Similarly, the two cuts parallel to the ac faces add 4ac, and the two cuts parallel to the bc faces add 4bc. Thus the new exposed area added by all cuts is 4(ab + ac + bc) = 2X. Adding the original exterior surface area X gives total surface area 3X.

图像描述：图中是一个长方体，外表面上画出了分割网格。正面能看到两条竖向内部分割线和两条横向内部分割线，表示在两个方向上各分成3段；顶面和右侧面上的网格线继续向后延伸，表示第三个方向也分成3段。因此该长方体被分成3×3×3=27个小长方体，对应总共六个内部切割平面：每一组相对面平行方向有两个切割平面。

推理：设原长方体三边长为a、b、c，则原表面积为X=2(ab+ac+bc)。两刀平行于面积为ab的一组面，每刀会产生两张新的内部暴露面，所以新增面积为2×2ab=4ab。类似地，两刀平行于面积为ac的一组面，新增4ac；两刀平行于面积为bc的一组面，新增4bc。全部切割新增面积为4(ab+ac+bc)。由于X=2(ab+ac+bc)，新增面积等于2X。所有27个小长方体的总表面积等于原外表面积加上所有新增切面面积，即X+2X=3X。

最终答案：3X
